lesson.name: Learn The Ruy Lopez Closed Variation
lesson.description: The Closed Ruy Lopez is one of the most popular openings throughout the history of chess. This lesson focuses specifically on the Chigorin and Breyer variations.

{How can Black develop strong counterplay against White's big center.} 9... Bg4
{[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a strong developing
move.] [%hint Pin the f3-knight.] Good choice! It's difficult for White to
defend the center after the knight is pinned. That's why White usually plays
h2-h3 prior to building a big center.} (9... exd4 $2 10. cxd4 {White builds a
big center. Try again and look for a useful developing move.}) (9... d5 $2 10.
dxe5 {White wins material. Try again and look for a strong developing move.}) (
9... Bb7 $2 10. Nbd2 {White has good center control and a safe advantage. Try
again and look for a better bishop move.}) (9... Be6 $2 10. d5 {White wins
material. Try again and look for a stronger bishop move.}) *

{White often plays an early b2-b4 to restrict the black queenside and Black
must be very careful about capturing the pawn. How should White win material?} 
21. Bd2 {[%wrong There's a better attacking move. Try again and look for a
strong threat.] [%hint Develop a bishop to target the b4-knight.]} (21. Qb3 $2
Qc3 {Black offers a queen trade and defends the knight. Try again and look for
a better move to attack the b4-knight.}) (21. Qd2 $5 {White is doing well, but
there's an even better move to attack the black knight. How should you do it?})
(21. Ba3 $2 Qc3 {Black attacks a1 and White's in trouble. Try again and look
for a stronger move to attack the black knight.}) 21... Qc5 {Black's knight
has no safe way to retreat. How should White win material?} 22. Qb3 {[%wrong
There's a better move. Try again and look for the best way to target the
b4-knight.] [%hint Attack Black's knight with your queen.] Well played! Black
has no way to save the knight.} (22. Qe2 $5 {White is doing well, but why not
immediately attack b4 with another piece?}) 1-0
